text: きみ　ポケモン　つよそう　だけど　りかは　とくい　なのかい？

structure.jp: ポケモン　つよそう　だけど

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう in place of the last い of a describing word means 'looks' that way. つよそう だ = 'looks strong'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. つよそう だけど = 'you look strong, but'.

patterns.name: 〜のかい
patterns.explanation: なの asks for an explanation and かい is a soft, friendly way to ask a question, used mostly by men. とくい なのかい = 'are you good at it, then?'
